integrity: Two standalone exact mod-two implementations checked all 16,384 induced subsets, including inclusion maps, with matching results; scientific review is not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exhaustive finite statement solely for the fourteen-vertex Fano incidence graph and mod-two third homology. A vertex-support minimum, not a minimum tetrahedron-count cycle. The twenty-eight listed dependencies classify only three-term circuits; longer relations exist. Does not imply integral, odd-characteristic or general projective-plane analogues. Publication-priority comparison is targeted, not exhaustive; independent mathematical review is outstanding.
title: Twenty-one minimal Heawood homology carriers and their Fano-plane relations
